Test restart, stale writes, invalid transitions, annotation capture/delivery, agent edit/test/review loop and narrow/fullscreen ergonomics. Deliver review and evidence covering Perso Template, Btr Template and TheBroccoli on existing task timeline. Keep explicit deferred features out of MVP and await user's acceptance.

## Serial acceptance scope
This existing integration/demonstration task now contains the earlier implementation records in one dependency chain. Verify their recorded work and remaining feedback before completing this demonstration. The existing planning/chat/annotation review targets this containing task, captures every child, and retains its required reviewer and repository checks. Do not treat regrouping as completion or approval.
